notes.title: Version 1.8.2 Released.
notes.notes:
2023/8/30 Build-245 Version 1.8.2 Release Note

1) 獲得・喪失するRANKポイントの値を調整しました。RANK(称号)が上がりやすくなりました。
2) 称号の高いプレイヤーが受けるラケットスイングの難易度の制約は、プレイヤー対戦の時のみになりました。プレイヤー対戦以外はすべての難易度を設定できるようになりました。また、ランクによって制約を受ける難易度を緩和しました。
3) 翻訳の不具合を修正しました。
4) プレイヤーの難易度についてのFAQをGUIDANCEに追加しました。
5) 通信対戦で相手が見つかりにくい問題を修正しました。
6) その他細かな不具合を修正しました。

1) The value of RANK points earned and lost has been adjusted; it is now easier to increase RANK (titles).
2) The restriction on the difficulty level of racket swings that players with higher titles receive is now only for player matches. All difficulty levels can now be set except for player matches. In addition, the difficulty restrictions imposed by rank have been relaxed.
3) Fixed a translation bug.
4) Added FAQ about player difficulty to GUIDANCE.
5) Fixed a problem in which it was difficult to find an opponent in a communication match.
6) Fixed other minor bugs.

Questions, bug reports, requests are here.
https://www.facebook.com/cybertennis.team
https://sidequestvr.com/app/2194/cyber-tennis

notes.title: New Update Version 1.8.1 Released!
notes.notes:
1) Revised the RANK point system, making it more difficult to maintain points at Master and higher ranks. Also, existing RANK points have been modified to GRANDSLAM+ values.
2) For Tour RANK and higher players, the difficulty of the racket swing now increases with RANK. Higher ranked players are required to play more accurate shots.
3) The highest rank title, "LEGEND", has been added, making it very difficult to maintain the LEGEND rank.
4) Partners and higher level computers have been made a little stronger.
5) A new character "HAENA" has been added.
6) The stage bosses have been changed to reflect the addition of new characters.
7) Changed the initial selection of partners.
8) Fixed other minor bugs.


Questions, bug reports, requests are here.
https://www.facebook.com/cybertennis.team
https://sidequestvr.com/app/2194/cyber-tennis

notes.title: New version 1.8.0 released!
notes.notes:
2023/1/21 Steam Build-231 Version 1.8.0 Release Note

1) The 2023 season event has begun.
2) Name and passcode management has changed and a security code has been added.
3) It is now possible to give food and drinks to pairs during doubles.　　
4) The rendering quality of the Kyoto Lake stage has been improved.
5) Improved the response of communication matches.
6) Minor UI improvements were made.
7) Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.7.9 released!
notes.notes:
2022/10/12 SteamVR Build-226 Version 1.7.9b Release Note

1) A new stage on Lake Kyoto has been added.
2) A new character [MUSASHI] has been added.
3) Special events that can be played throughout the year have been added to the Seasonal Events. 
4) More characters can be partnered in missions.
5) In serving during swing shots, it is now possible to serve by tossing without locking the target.
6) You can now play against stage bosses in practice matches.
7) Adjusted the character's strong and weak courts.
8) Fixed a problem with drop shots not hitting properly.
9) The change of the ball when serving has been made stronger.
10) Optimization has been performed to reduce processing load and load time.
11) Fixed other minor bugs.
.
We have confirmed that it works with PICO4 Streaming. It can be played without any problem.

notes.title: New version 1.7.8 updated! and gift for you!
notes.notes:
1) Julia and Ethan have been added to the player's avatar characters.
2) Character graphics have been improved.
3) Gifts have been distributed to celebrate the first anniversary.
4) You can now get RobotKyle as a partner in Missions. However, you need to be level 100.
5) Fixed some other minor bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.7.7a Update Notice
notes.notes:
Windows MR devices, which were not supported at the time of release, are now supported.
It can be played just like any other model.
We have confirmed that the game can be played comfortably on laptops with GeForce 1650.
Thank you for your continued support.
